quarterly_data.signal: Xcel's 8-K: on October 9, 2026 subsidiary NSP-Minnesota filed an Electric Customer Rate Stability Plan with the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission as an alternative to its planned rate case: a customer base rate freeze for calendar years 2027 and 2028, accelerated recognition over two years of federal Investment Tax Credit benefits from five battery storage projects to offset the revenue requirement of ongoing capital improvements, and continuation of the existing true-up and tracker mechanisms. A decision has been requested by January 2027; if the plan is not approved, NSP-Minnesota expects to file an electric rate case in early 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: base rate freeze for 2027 and 2028; five battery storage projects; decision requested by January 2027
